_about: Hand-kept outcome of the 2026-10-09 cross-check: every fetched arXiv title/abstract was read against the sentence that cites the id in sections/*.md and against its row in ../references.md. 'mismatch' lists ids whose arXiv record is not the work the text describes (none found). 'venue_withheld' lists ids whose only venue statement is in references.md and is not solid; they are printed as arXiv preprints. 2026-10-22: the three withheld venues were checked against OpenReview and the MLSys proceedings (LoftQ ICLR 2024 oral, LQ-LoRA ICLR 2024 poster, Punica MLSys 2024) and released; seven references.md short names gained venues found the same day (MiLo, GlowQ, Sheared-LLaMA, Minitron, MPK, FLRQ, TileQ; review/litsweep-2026-10-22/R6-serving-refs.md). author_fix: FLRQ's arXiv listing misspells its first author; AAAI and PMLR spell it Gu.
